title: Seed ecophysiology and plant population ecology of Cynoglossum officinale L. and Tragopogon spp.
why: Cynoglossum sense_light_nonvisual: a thesis on the seed ecophysiology of Cynoglossum officinale that came up for the Cynoglossum photoperiod query. The abstract start covers seed dormancy and germination (the seed coat and oxygen supply) and mentions no light treatment, so the text may or may not compare germination in light and in darkness, the kind of response main logs as non-visual light sensing for other plants. The listing gives no author list and the thesis was not opened.

title: Probing ozone effects on European hornbeam (Carpinus betulus L. and Ostrya carpinifolia Scop.) leaf water content through THz imaging and dynamic stomatal response
journal: The Science of The Total Environment
why: Ostrya sense_light_nonvisual: a free-air ozone study of European hornbeam (Carpinus betulus) and Ostrya carpinifolia, a congener of the queue species Ostrya virginiana; the abstract says leaf gas exchange measurements assessed stomatal responses to light variation, so its text may report how the stomata of an Ostrya species respond to a change in light, a non-visual light response. The abstract start gives no Ostrya value, the listing gives no author list and the paper was not opened. It also came up for the Ostrya volatile signalling query.
